# JOJO Papers — Comprehensive Technical & OEM Specifications

> Complete B2B Manufacturing Reference for Pre-Rolled Cones, Rolling Papers, Filter Tips & Custom Packaging.

## 1. Company Overview
JOJO Papers is an OEM / Private-Label manufacturer headquartered in Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, India. Operating continuously since 2014, JOJO Papers produces high-precision pre-rolled cones, rolling paper booklets, and filter tips for global brands, dispensaries, and high-volume commercial filling operations.

## 2. Pre-Rolled Cones Specifications
Every cone is hand-formed around an integrated filter tip with strict tolerance control to ensure consistent airflow and compatibility with automated packing machines (Knockbox, King Kone, etc.).

### Standard Cone Formats
1. **DogWalker (70 mm)**
   - Total Length: 70 mm
   - Tip Length: 26 mm
   - Capacity: ~0.25 g – 0.35 g
   - Ideal For: Single-session, mini, and on-the-go pre-rolls.
2. **Mini (78 mm)**
   - Total Length: 78 mm
   - Tip Length: 26 mm
   - Capacity: ~0.5 g
   - Ideal For: Standard half-gram commercial pre-roll SKUs.
3. **1¼ Size (84 mm)**
   - Total Length: 84 mm
   - Tip Length: 26 mm
   - Capacity: ~0.75 g
   - Ideal For: The industry-standard 3/4 gram consumer size.
4. **98 mm Special (98 mm)**
   - Total Length: 98 mm
   - Tip Length: 26 mm / 20 mm
   - Capacity: ~0.75 g – 1.0 g
   - Ideal For: Slim 1-gram formats with lower paper-to-flower ratio.
5. **King Size (109 mm)**
   - Total Length: 109 mm
   - Tip Length: 26 mm
   - Capacity: ~1.0 g – 1.3 g
   - Ideal For: Full 1-gram and multi-user pre-roll offerings.
6. **Custom Dimensions**
   - Project-based cone lengths and tip sizes upon request.

### Paper Base Options for Cones
- **Wood Pulp**: Ultra-refined classic paper base offering consistent, even combustion.
- **Rice**: Ultra-thin, slow-burning paper with minimal ash profile.
- **Hemp**: 100% natural organic hemp fibers with smooth draw characteristics.
- **Flax**: High-tensile, ultra-clean plant fibers for delicate rolling papers.

### Paper Colour Directions
- **Unbleached**: Natural earth-brown shade without chemical bleaching agents.
- **Bleached**: Clean, crisp white presentation.
- **Coloured Papers**: Pink, Light Blue, Mint Green, Lilac Purple, and Black (food-grade natural dyes).

## 3. Bulk Cones & Wholesale Supply
Supplied in rigid tower packs and protective master trays designed for volume handlers, distributors, and automated vibratory loading machines.
- **Standard Tower Counts**: 800-count, 900-count, 1,000-count, and master cartons (up to 10,000+ units).

## 4. Filter Tip Constructions
- **Spiral Construction**: Tightly rolled multi-layered spiral for smooth airflow and complete filtration.
- **M-Shape (W-Shape) Construction**: Folded internal accordion truss for maximum particulate blocking and structural firmness.
- **Tip Branding**: Plain / unprinted, single-color logo stamp, multi-color branding, or continuous pattern print.

## 5. Rolling Papers & Booklets
- **Standard Sizes**: 1¼ (78 × 44 mm) and King Size Slim (108 × 44 mm).
- **Booklet Configurations**:
  - Standard Single Booklet (32 to 50 leaves).
  - Premium Booklet with integrated elastic closure.
  - Magnetic Closure Booklet.
  - Papers + Filter Tips Combo Pack (with perforated tip sheets or pre-rolled tips).
  - Value / Compact Multi-Pack.

## 6. Retail Packaging Solutions
- **Counter Display Units (CDUs)**: Pop-up retail display boxes for dispensary counters and retail shelves.
- **Rigid Drawer Boxes & Slider Packs**: High-end consumer packaging with pull ribbons.
- **Rigid Paper Tubes**: Child-resistant and pop-top compatible formats.
- **Embossed Metal Tins**: Collectible metal packaging for premium cone collections.
- **Hanging Blister & Retail Cards**: Pegboard display packaging.

## 7. Quality Control & Indian Sourcing Consultation
JOJO Papers provides independent third-party quality control inspections for buyers sourcing paper products in India:
- Paper grammage and burn rate verification.
- Seam adhesion and gum line purity testing.
- Dimensional tolerance checks.
- Pre-shipment packaging and moisture barrier audits.
